tn: TN is a state in east central United States.
TN means the same as Tennessee or Volunteer State or Tenn..
tnf: TNF is a proinflammatory cytokine that is produced by white blood cells.
TNF means the same as tumor necrosis factor or tumour necrosis factor.
tnt: TNT is explosive consisting of a yellow crystalline compound that is a flammable toxic derivative of toluene.
TNT means the same as trinitrotoluene.
